findings.disposition: supported source defect; runtime baseline required
findings.cause: float parsing has no finite/nonnegative guard. Accepted Android browser construction/entry precedes sleep receiving arbitrary hold values.
findings.consequence: Invalid duration is discovered, if at all, after device mutation; precise native sleep exceptions/timing not measured.
findings.minimal_remedy: After parse/required browser guard, parser.error unless math.isfinite(hold) and hold>=0. Keep0 valid, impose no arbitrary maximum; no renderer/timeout change.
findings.controls: Actual main argv for -1/nan/inf/-inf, forbidden launcher sentinel, require SystemExit2 before constructor/entry/environment side effects. Positive0/0.25/default8 preserve exact body sleep budget through minimal launch context witness; no hardware/capture parity claim.

findings.disposition: supported source defect in callable same-process usage
findings.cause: --allow-cold-boot permanently writes process-global environment even when --print-arguments returns without launching.
findings.consequence: A later default AndroidSession in the same process bypasses snapshot marker checking. Separate standalone CLI process does not mutate its parent process; no cross-process claim.
findings.minimal_remedy: Prefer actual per-launch android_allow_cold_boot field in LaunchPlan forwarded to existing AndroidLaunch.allow_cold_boot, replacing CLI environment assignment. Existing explicit ambient environment opt-in stays honored. This is applied concrete configuration with one real CLI caller, not a generic environment context framework.
findings.controls: Actual print-arguments call with flag must preserve absent/existing environment key and launch nothing. Same-process subsequent canonical require_snapshot on empty marker must still refuse. Flag-enabled actual main must produce plan/session opt-in for only that launch; no flag remains false. Literal existing environment opt-in remains a separate positive.

findings.disposition: supported status-contract defect under controlled CompletedProcess results
findings.cause: Both safety guards parse stdout after check=False has discarded nonzero process status. Status7 with stdout1 can identify an emulator; nonempty snapshot stdout can accept a marker.
findings.consequence: Failed required observation may authorize mutation; empty error stdout instead fails closed but loses original command failure diagnosis. Natural adb output shapes not measured.
findings.minimal_remedy: Use existing checked default for only the required getprop guard calls. Preserve legitimate status0 empty property fallback/refusal and explicit per-launch/ambient opt-ins; do not change internal subprocess.run(check=False), whose manual RuntimeError handling is correct.
findings.controls: Actual AdbDevice.run/shell with only subprocess.run modeled. Negative emulator1/nonzero and nonempty-marker/nonzero require canonical-created error identity/command context before any force-stop/clear/reverse/config mutation. Positive status0 marker acceptance and status0 empty first property then second1 fallback; missing snapshot remains ColdBootRefused. Backup registered before acquisition; no device.

findings.disposition: supported source false-positive outcome under controlled query failure
findings.cause: Two failed dumpsys window commands with empty stdout produce no focus lines and are counted as two successful away observations.
findings.consequence: finish_onboarding returns without successful focus or final-label evidence. In the only declared onboarding recipe Opera, _open may then proceed to target intent.
findings.minimal_remedy: Check the required dumpsys status before treating its data as activity evidence. Preserve successful UI transitional/absence semantics until separately reviewed; zero-status missing-focus handling is a distinct candidate, not proven by nonzero controls.
findings.controls: Pair healthy actual canonical finish_onboarding with two distinct decoded away focus observations, and two controlled nonzero empty process results. Require original canonical query error, no success return/no target-intent advance before backup. Use finite concrete clock/sleep boundary controls for polling only; no OS/window observation provenance claim.

findings.disposition: supported source stale/failed-data acceptance under controlled query failure
findings.cause: Failed uiautomator dump does not prevent reading persistent WINDOW_DUMP; old valid XML is accepted. Failed cat also supplies unchecked stdout to parsers.
findings.consequence: Focused field can be accepted from a failed/stale observation, allowing type_url return then Enter; onboarding can similarly tap retained labels. Existing tests cover successful parse/empty XML polling, not failed status freshness.
findings.minimal_remedy: Checked defaults for the concrete dump/read observation calls, preserving status0 malformed/absent-focus and valid ANR None/retry semantics. If nonzero UI failures are intentionally retried, an explicit status-aware observation policy retaining original failure is needed first; do not infer harmlessness from stderr text.
findings.controls: Real owned local material represents the pre-existing XML payload at the subprocess boundary; actual canonical dump/cat/focused/type path remains active. Pair healthy fresh observation with nonzero dump plus retained matching XML, and nonzero cat plus success-shaped XML. Require exact canonical error/context and no Enter/tap before independent backup. Finite polling/clock witness; no actual device claim.
